Message.OSA.Description1: The Online Safety Act (OSA) is a UK law that requires regulated user-to-user service providers to implement tools that allow reporting of content that may be illegal.

The information you provide will help us identify the content you’re reporting and determine whether the content violates our Community Standards or is otherwise illegal under UK laws. Message.AUOSA.Description1: The Australian Online Safety Act requires regulated services to have accessible reporting and complaints mechanisms for harmful and illegal content and for age restricted material. This form allows you to report or complain about content regulated under Australia's online safety laws or Roblox's safety standards, including material that concerns the non-consensual sharing of intimate images, grooming of children, or sexual extortion as well as adult or pornographic material, self-harm material, simulated gambling material, high-impact violence material, or other adult-themed material.
Title.AUOSA.Content: Report Harmful, Illegal, or Age-Restricted Content
Message.AUOSA.Description2: To make a report or complaint about harmful, illegal, inappropriate, or age-restricted content on Roblox, please include as much detail as possible in the form below. The information you provide will help us identify the content you're reporting and determine whether that content violates our Community Standards or otherwise requires us to take action under the Australian Online Safety Act. If your report does not include sufficient information, we may not be able to take action.

Message.AUOSANonCompliance.Description1: The Australian Online Safety Act requires Roblox to comply with certain obligations to keep users safe online. These include requirements relating to detecting, removing, and responding to harmful or illegal content and age restricted content on Roblox, enforcing our Terms of Use and Community Standards, having certain safety tools and settings, and allowing users to report or complain about harmful or illegal material and age restricted material. This form allows you to make a complaint about Roblox's compliance with Australian online safety laws, including the Online Safety (Relevant Electronic Services-Class 1A and Class 1B Material) Industry Standard 2024 and the Relevant Electronic Services Online Safety Code (Class 1C and Class 2 Material).
Message.AUOSANonCompliance.Description2: To make a complaint about how Roblox is complying with these laws, please include as much detail as possible in the form below. The information you provide will help us identify and address the matter that is the subject of your complaint. If your report does not include sufficient information, we may not be able to take action.
Message.AUOSANonCompliance.Description3: Once you submit your report, provided that you submit valid contact information, you will receive a confirmation email, an update on the outcome of your report, and, as applicable, the opportunity to appeal our decision.

Message.USNCII.Description1: United States law (47 U.S. Code § 223a) requires online platforms to provide a process for individuals to request removal of nonconsensual intimate imagery depicting them.
Message.USNCII.Description2: To file a removal request, please include as much detail as possible in the form below. The information you provide will help us identify the content you’re reporting and determine whether the content violates our Community Standards or is otherwise illegal under USA laws. If your report does not include sufficient information, we may not be able to take action.
Message.USNCII.Description3: Once you submit your report, provided that you submit valid contact information, you will receive a confirmation email. Our team will then review your request and take any necessary action within 48 hours.
